verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents several official building blocks — a JS SDK (Segment-API compatible), a React integration, an HTTP API, a Functions SDK/CLI, and the jitsu-cli for managing configs — giving AI-native builders official ways to integrate. However, evidence doesn't show a broad multi-language SDK ecosystem (e.g. Python, Go, mobile SDKs) typical of analytics platforms, nor independent corroboration of SDK quality beyond Jitsu's own docs. missing for 10: multi-language/server SDKs beyond HTTP API, independent hands-on validation of SDK usability.
